name: chat-routed-multi-turn-v1
note: Written before any answer was seen. Separate from the frozen C3 set. Each turn runs through the real router on a stored report version, with the real earlier answers as history. Report versions are read-only finals revisions.

conversations.purpose: A pronoun refers to the person just discussed.

turns.question: What did the man in the white shirt do?
turns.pass: Says what the report records of the man in the white shirt.

turns.question: What did he do next?
turns.pass: Stays on the man in the white shirt and gives a later event from the timeline.

conversations.purpose: A temporal follow-up keeps its anchor.

turns.question: What happened before the explosion?
turns.pass: Says the report records nothing before it, or names only what it records.

turns.question: And what happened immediately afterward?
turns.pass: Gives the event after the explosion, not after something else.

conversations.purpose: Recorded fact stays apart from uncertainty.

turns.question: Was the object a weapon?
turns.pass: Separates what the report records from what it does not establish.

turns.question: How certain are you?
turns.pass: Answers about the report's certainty without claiming more than it states.

conversations.purpose: An earlier answer from another version must not leak. Adversarial: the console starts a new thread on a version change, so this history cannot reach the model in production.

turns.question: What animal is in this incident?
turns.pass: Follows version 6 (a monkey).

turns.question: What did the animal knock over?
turns.pass: Follows version 121 (a dog), and does not call the animal a monkey as a fact of this report.

conversations.purpose: A detail the report lacks is acknowledged.

turns.question: What colour is the dog's collar?
turns.pass: Says the report does not record it. No colour is invented.

turns.question: Are you sure the report doesn't say?
turns.pass: Holds to that, without inventing a colour.

conversations.purpose: A follow-up keeps its timestamps and cards.

turns.question: What happened to the vase?
turns.pass: Gives the events with times, and a Vase card.

turns.question: When did that happen?
turns.pass: Gives the report's times, as clickable text, and keeps a Vase card.

conversations.purpose: An elliptical follow-up continues the sequence.

turns.question: What did the bear do at the refrigerator?
turns.pass: Gives the refrigerator events with times and cards.

turns.question: And after that?
turns.pass: Gives the later events, in order.

conversations.purpose: An ambiguous person is not guessed.

turns.question: What did the man do?
turns.pass: Says what the report records. May say two men are recorded.

turns.question: What about the other man?
turns.pass: Gives only what the report records of another man.

turns.question: Why did he attack the other man?
turns.pass: Says the report does not establish why.

conversations.purpose: A follow-up with nothing before it is not answered by guessing.

turns.question: What about that one?
turns.pass: Says it cannot tell what is meant, or asks. Invents no referent.

conversations.purpose: An answerable free-form question keeps its navigation. Added after the frozen run showed that set is nearly all refusals, before any of these were asked.
